$comment: Generated by scripts/aifn-catalog.ts (make catalog) from the registries of aifn and aifn-applied; do not edit. Each entry is its registry info with Spaces inlined, addressed <module>/<key> within its kind.

agent.name: Cross-entropy method
agent.summary: Searches linear threshold policies by the cross-entropy method: sample a population, keep the elite, refit, repeat.

agent.name: LQR bang-bang
agent.summary: Pushes in the direction of the LQR force about the origin, from autodiff Jacobians of the model: a two-action baseline.

agent.name: Energy swing-up + LQR
agent.summary: Pumps the pendulum’s energy to the upright’s, then balances it with an LQR gain from autodiff Jacobians of the model.

agent.name: Deep Q-network
agent.summary: A multilayer perceptron Q(o, ·) trained by Adam on Huber TD errors from an experience-replay buffer, with a target network and ε-greedy exploration.

agent.name: ε-greedy
agent.summary: The best empirical mean, or with probability ε a uniformly random arm (optionally decaying as cK/t).

agent.name: EXP3
agent.summary: Exponential weights on importance-weighted rewards, mixed with uniform exploration: for adversarial arms.

agent.name: Expected SARSA
agent.summary: TD control bootstrapping from the expected action value under the ε-greedy policy.

agent.name: Explore then commit
agent.summary: Pulls every arm m times in turn, then the best empirical mean for ever.

agent.name: KL-UCB
agent.summary: Pulls the arm with the largest KL upper confidence bound; asymptotically optimal for Bernoulli arms.

agent.name: LinUCB
agent.summary: Ridge regression on the arms’ features plus an exploration bonus α‖x‖ in the inverse design matrix.

agent.name: Linear Thompson sampling
agent.summary: Draws θ from the ridge posterior N(θ̂, v²V⁻¹) and pulls the arm whose features score highest under it.

agent.name: Monte Carlo control
agent.summary: First-visit Monte Carlo control with an ε-soft policy: action values average the returns that followed.

agent.name: n-step SARSA
agent.summary: SARSA with n-step returns: n rewards, then the value of the action taken n steps later.

agent.name: Advantage actor–critic (A2C)
agent.summary: Actor and critic updated every n steps on n-step advantages, with an entropy bonus.

agent.name: Deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG)
agent.summary: A tanh actor and a Q critic from replayed transitions, the actor ascending the critic by the deterministic policy gradient, with Polyak target networks and Gaussian exploration.

agent.name: Proximal policy optimisation (PPO)
agent.summary: Clipped-ratio surrogate over several epochs of minibatches from each rollout, with GAE(λ) advantages.

agent.name: REINFORCE with baseline
agent.summary: A neural softmax policy updated after each episode by returns minus a learned value baseline.

agent.name: Policy iteration (planner)
agent.summary: Solves the environment’s tabular model by policy iteration, then acts greedily on the optimal Q.

agent.name: Q-learning
agent.summary: ε-greedy Q-learning: one off-policy TD update towards r + γ max Q per transition.

agent.name: Random agent
agent.summary: Acts uniformly at random over the legal actions or the action domain and learns nothing: the baseline.

agent.name: REINFORCE
agent.summary: A tabular softmax policy improved by the score-function gradient of each episode’s returns.

agent.name: SARSA
agent.summary: On-policy TD control: each update bootstraps from the value of the action actually taken next.

agent.name: One-step TD control
agent.summary: Q-learning, SARSA or expected SARSA by `method`: ε-greedy TD control on discrete observations.

agent.name: TD(0) prediction
agent.summary: Follows a fixed policy (default uniformly random) and learns its state values by one-step TD updates.

agent.name: Thompson sampling (Bernoulli)
agent.summary: Draws each arm’s success probability from its Beta posterior and pulls the largest draw.

agent.name: Thompson sampling (Gaussian)
agent.summary: Draws each arm’s mean from its Gaussian posterior (known noise) and pulls the largest draw.

agent.name: UCB1
agent.summary: Pulls the arm with the largest upper confidence bound, the mean plus √(c ln t / n).

agent.name: Uniform (round robin)
agent.summary: Pulls the arms in turn, an A/B/n test: linear regret, the baseline of the bandit policies.

agent.name: Value iteration (planner)
agent.summary: Solves the environment’s tabular model by value iteration, then acts greedily on Q*: the optimal baseline.

algorithm.name: LQG closed loop
algorithm.summary: A noisy plant under u = −Kx̂ with the Kalman predictor x̂; noise drawn from the step stream.

algorithm.name: PID control loop
algorithm.summary: A discrete PID controller around a SISO plant, with a filtered derivative, actuator limits and anti-windup.

algorithm.name: Receding-horizon control
algorithm.summary: Plan N steps by a QP from the measured state, apply the first input, repeat.

algorithm.name: Map iteration
algorithm.summary: x_{n+1} = f(x_n) for a map of the line or of ℝᵈ, one iterate per step.

algorithm.name: Adaptive BDF
algorithm.summary: Variable-order (1–5), variable-step backward differentiation formulae (NDF) for stiff problems, as scipy BDF.

algorithm.name: Backward differentiation formula
algorithm.summary: The BDF methods of order 1 to 3 for stiff problems.

algorithm.name: Dormand–Prince
algorithm.summary: The adaptive 5(4) embedded Runge–Kutta pair with error-controlled step sizes.

algorithm.name: Explicit Runge–Kutta
algorithm.summary: A fixed-step explicit Runge–Kutta method from a Butcher tableau (Euler, Heun, midpoint, RK4).

algorithm.name: Symplectic integrator
algorithm.summary: Symplectic Euler, leapfrog and higher-order splittings for separable Hamiltonians.

algorithm.name: Density of a scalar SDE
algorithm.summary: The density of dX = a(X) dt + σ(X) dW evolved by its Fokker–Planck equation.

algorithm.name: Fokker–Planck equation
algorithm.summary: p_t = −(ap)_x + (Dp)_xx in conservative form with reflecting ends.

algorithm.name: Heat equation
algorithm.summary: u_t = D u_xx by the method of lines: FTCS, implicit Euler or Crank–Nicolson.

algorithm.name: Transport equation
algorithm.summary: u_t + c u_x = 0 by upwind, Lax–Friedrichs or Lax–Wendroff differences.

algorithm.name: Wave equation
algorithm.summary: u_tt = c² u_xx by the leapfrog scheme.

algorithm.name: Blelloch scan
algorithm.summary: The work-efficient parallel prefix: an up-sweep of partial reductions, then a down-sweep of prefixes.

algorithm.name: Hillis–Steele scan
algorithm.summary: The inclusive parallel prefix in ⌈log₂ n⌉ rounds, each position combining with the one 2^t before it.

algorithm.name: DDIM sampling
algorithm.summary: Deterministic (η = 0) or partly stochastic sampling on a subsequence of the noise levels.

algorithm.name: Denoiser training
algorithm.summary: Minibatch MSE between predicted and true noise at a random level per point (the simplified DDPM loss).

algorithm.name: Forward noising chain
algorithm.summary: x_t = √αₜ x_{t−1} + √βₜ ε, one step per noise level, until x_T is nearly N(0, I).

algorithm.name: Probability-flow ODE sampler
algorithm.summary: The deterministic ODE dx = [f − ½g²∇log p_t] dt with the same marginals as the forward SDE.

algorithm.name: Reverse-time SDE sampler
algorithm.summary: Euler–Maruyama on dx = [f − g²∇log p_t] dt + g dw̄, backwards in time.

algorithm.name: JEM training
algorithm.summary: Cross-entropy plus persistent contrastive divergence on the energy −logsumexp of the logits.

algorithm.name: GAN training
algorithm.summary: Alternating discriminator and generator updates under the minimax, non-saturating, WGAN-GP or hinge game.

algorithm.name: Edmonds–Karp
algorithm.summary: Maximum flow by shortest augmenting paths.

algorithm.name: Minimum-cost flow
algorithm.summary: Minimum-cost flow by successive shortest paths with potentials.

algorithm.name: Label propagation
algorithm.summary: F ← D⁻¹WF with the labelled rows clamped, converging to the harmonic solution.

algorithm.name: Label spreading
algorithm.summary: F ← αSF + (1 − α)Y from F₀ = Y.

algorithm.name: Policy iteration
algorithm.summary: Evaluate the policy exactly, then improve it greedily, until it stops changing.

algorithm.name: Value iteration
algorithm.summary: Bellman optimality backups V ← max_a [r + γ P V] until the residual is small.

algorithm.name: Bayes point machine (EP)
algorithm.summary: A Gaussian posterior over linear-classifier weights by expectation propagation, one site per example.

algorithm.name: CAVI for a Gaussian with unknown mean and precision
algorithm.summary: Coordinate ascent on q(μ)q(τ); each update raises the ELBO.

algorithm.name: Chain sum–product
algorithm.summary: Sum–product (or max–product) on a chain-shaped factor graph.

algorithm.name: Enumeration
algorithm.summary: Exact inference by enumerating every assignment.

algorithm.name: Expectation propagation over a linear-Gaussian model
Variational Bayesian Gaussian mixture
algorithm.summary: CAVI on q(π) q(μ, Λ) q(z) for a Gaussian mixture; the ELBO never decreases.

algorithm.name: TrueSkill by expectation propagation
algorithm.summary: Skills from a sequence of matches, by EP over the match factor graphs.

algorithm.name: Template CRF training
algorithm.summary: L-BFGS, OWL-QN (L1 + L2), SGD or Adam on the regularised conditional log-likelihood.

algorithm.name: Gibbs sampling on a factor graph
Langevin on a batch of particles
Correlated topic model (MAP EM)
algorithm.summary: Logistic-normal topic proportions: posterior modes per document by L-BFGS, then topics and (μ, Σ).

algorithm.name: Dynamic topic model (MAP variational EM)
algorithm.summary: Topics drift between time slices as a Gaussian random walk in their natural parameters; variational LDA per document, each topic chain at its posterior mode.

algorithm.name: HDP topic model by direct-assignment Gibbs sampling
algorithm.summary: LDA with unboundedly many topics: tokens join used topics or open new ones, and the shared topic weights are redrawn from table counts.

algorithm.name: LDA by collapsed Gibbs sampling
algorithm.summary: Resamples each token’s topic from its full conditional with θ and φ integrated out; one sweep per step.

algorithm.name: pLSA by EM
algorithm.summary: Alternate topic responsibilities of each (document, word) pair and the two conditional distributions.

algorithm.name: Blahut–Arimoto (capacity)
algorithm.summary: Alternating maximisation of I(X; Y) over the input distribution, with upper and lower bounds.

algorithm.name: Huffman coding
algorithm.summary: Pop the D least-weight roots off a priority queue, join them under a new node and push it back, until one tree remains; binary or D-ary, with a tie-breaking rule.

algorithm.name: Pool adjacent violators
algorithm.summary: Add points one at a time and pool the last two blocks while they violate the order.

algorithm.name: GPLVM fit
algorithm.summary: L-BFGS on the latent positions and kernel hyperparameters of a GPLVM, maximising the log posterior.

algorithm.name: RVM by fast marginal-likelihood maximisation
algorithm.summary: Tipping and Faul: add, re-estimate or delete one basis function (or update β) per step by the largest gain.

algorithm.name: RVM by re-estimation
algorithm.summary: Tipping (2001): αᵢ ← γᵢ/μᵢ² and β ← (N − Σγ)/‖y − Φμ‖² for all basis functions per step, with pruning.

algorithm.name: Sparse GP fit by L-BFGS
algorithm.summary: L-BFGS on the sparse objective (the VFE bound, or FITC/DTC/SoR evidence) over log θ, log σ² and Z.

algorithm.name: Sparse GP by greedy inducing-point selection
algorithm.summary: Add the candidate training input that most raises the sparse objective, one per step, optionally re-optimising.

algorithm.name: Backfitting
algorithm.summary: Cycle over the terms of an additive model, smoothing the partial residuals of each in turn.

algorithm.name: Explainable boosting machine
algorithm.summary: Cyclic gradient boosting of one binned shape function per feature, with a small learning rate.

algorithm.name: GAM by Adam
algorithm.summary: Adam on the penalised deviance per observation, full batch, with the gradient by autodiff.

algorithm.name: GAM by backfitting
algorithm.summary: Backfitting with local scoring: one sweep of penalised smoothers over the terms per step.

algorithm.name: GAM by gradient descent
algorithm.summary: Gradient descent on the penalised deviance per observation, with the gradient by autodiff.

algorithm.name: GAM by L-BFGS
algorithm.summary: L-BFGS with a strong Wolfe line search on the penalised deviance per observation, by autodiff.

algorithm.name: GAM by penalised IRLS
algorithm.summary: Penalised IRLS on a GAM problem: weighted ridge-type solves on the working response, with step halving.

algorithm.name: GAM by minibatch SGD
algorithm.summary: Stochastic gradient descent on minibatch estimates of the penalised deviance, by autodiff.

algorithm.name: Negative binomial GLM by alternation
algorithm.summary: Alternate IRLS for the coefficients and a one-dimensional MLE for the dispersion θ.

algorithm.name: Iteratively reweighted least squares
algorithm.summary: Fisher scoring for a GLM as weighted least squares on the working response, optionally penalised.

algorithm.name: Pegasos
algorithm.summary: Stochastic subgradient descent on the primal SVM objective.

algorithm.name: Sequential minimal optimisation
algorithm.summary: Update two dual variables per step in closed form.

algorithm.name: Perceptron
algorithm.summary: Visit one example per step and add yx to the weights when it is misclassified; the averaged weights too.

algorithm.name: Mixture density network training by Adam
algorithm.summary: Minibatch Adam on the mixture negative log-likelihood of an MLP with a Gaussian-mixture head (or the squared error of the same body).

algorithm.name: EM for a mixture of linear experts
algorithm.summary: E-step responsibilities from the gate and each expert’s likelihood; M-step weighted least squares (or IRLS) per expert and a soft-target logistic refit of the gate, flat or hierarchical.

algorithm.name: Mixture-of-experts training by Adam
algorithm.summary: Minibatch Adam on the data loss plus the load-balancing, importance and router z auxiliary losses.

algorithm.name: Subgroup discovery
algorithm.summary: Search a table’s conjunctive descriptions for the top k subgroups by a quality measure: beam, best-first or exhaustive, with branch and bound by optimistic estimates.

algorithm.name: Random forest growth
algorithm.summary: One tree per step on a bootstrap sample with random feature subsets.

algorithm.name: AdaBoost
algorithm.summary: One weak learner per step on reweighted examples; the vote weight grows with its accuracy.

algorithm.name: Gradient boosting
algorithm.summary: One regression tree per step fitted to the negative gradient of the loss, added with shrinkage.

algorithm.name: Decision-tree growth
algorithm.summary: Split one node per step by the best impurity decrease, in depth-, breadth- or best-first order.

algorithm.name: Active learning with label proportions
algorithm.summary: Query a bag of pool points (US-Mass, US-LP, random or exact), add the oracle’s proportion as a bag, refit LP-LLP.

algorithm.name: Dawid–Skene EM
algorithm.summary: Alternate posteriors over the true class and each voter’s confusion matrix; the likelihood never falls.

algorithm.name: Label propagation for label proportions (LP-LLP)
algorithm.summary: Start each point at its bag’s proportions; propagate over the graph, project back onto the bags’ class masses, repeat.

algorithm.name: FOIL (sequential covering)
algorithm.summary: Quinlan's FOIL: grow one clause at a time by the literal of highest FOIL gain until it covers no negatives, remove the positives it covers, repeat.

algorithm.name: SLD resolution (Prolog)
algorithm.summary: Depth-first SLD resolution with backtracking: each step resolves the first goal with the next clause whose head unifies, runs a built-in, or backtracks; cut, negation as failure and findall included.

algorithm.name: Node classification by Adam
algorithm.summary: Full-batch Adam on the labelled nodes’ cross-entropy of a two-layer GNN.

algorithm.name: FlashAttention forward pass
algorithm.summary: Attention one tile of queries × keys at a time, folding each into a running maximum, normaliser and output.

algorithm.name: Beam search
algorithm.summary: Keep the B best partial sequences by length-penalised log-probability, recording the search tree.

algorithm.name: Greedy decoding
algorithm.summary: Append the most probable next token, one token per step.

algorithm.name: Sampling with temperature, top-k, top-p and repetition penalty
algorithm.summary: Draw each next token from the processed next-token distribution.

algorithm.name: Speculative decoding
algorithm.summary: Draft γ tokens with a small model, verify them with the target, keep the target’s distribution exactly.

algorithm.name: Adversarial training
algorithm.summary: Alternating gradient steps on a critic and a generator, k critic steps per generator step.

algorithm.name: Persistent contrastive divergence
algorithm.summary: Energy-based-model training with Langevin negatives from a replay buffer, plus an optional supervised term.

algorithm.name: Full-batch training (L-BFGS)
algorithm.summary: A network trained on the whole set by a vector method (L-BFGS by default): the parameter tree raveled to θ, the loss and its gradient on all the data.

algorithm.name: Training by method (first-order or L-BFGS)
algorithm.summary: A network trained by a chosen method with one state shape: an update rule through the training loop, or full-batch L-BFGS.

algorithm.name: DP-SGD
algorithm.summary: Poisson-sampled per-example gradients clipped to norm C and noised with N(0, σ²C²), with the ε spent by RDP accounting.

algorithm.name: Training loop
algorithm.summary: Minibatch training of a network: forward, loss, gradients and an optimiser update per step.

algorithm.name: NMF by multiplicative updates or HALS
algorithm.summary: Alternate W and H updates (Lee–Seung ratios of the gradient’s parts, or exact HALS column updates); never increases.

algorithm.name: Gauss–Seidel and SOR
algorithm.summary: Sweeps that use each updated component at once, with optional over-relaxation ω.

algorithm.name: Gram–Schmidt
algorithm.summary: Orthonormalise the columns one at a time, classical or modified; after n steps A = QR.

algorithm.name: Householder QR
algorithm.summary: One reflector per column maps it onto a multiple of e₁ below the diagonal; QR = A throughout.

algorithm.name: Jacobi iteration
algorithm.summary: x ← D⁻¹(b − (L + U)x), every component from the previous iterate.

algorithm.name: Power iteration
algorithm.summary: v ← Av/‖Av‖ with the Rayleigh quotient as the eigenvalue estimate; inverse iteration with a shift.

algorithm.name: RANSAC
algorithm.summary: Fit minimal random samples, keep the model with most inliers, stop at the adaptive sample count.

algorithm.name: Continuation
algorithm.summary: Natural-parameter continuation from an easy problem to the target, with a Newton corrector.

algorithm.name: Linear conjugate gradient
algorithm.summary: Conjugate gradient for Ax = b with A symmetric positive definite.

algorithm.name: Fixed share
algorithm.summary: Hedge that hands back a share α of the mass each round, to track the best switching expert.

algorithm.name: Follow the regularised leader
algorithm.summary: Minimise the linearised cumulative loss plus a regulariser (L2, L1, or the adaptive FTRL-Proximal form).

algorithm.name: Hedge (exponential weights)
algorithm.summary: Play the softmax of the negated cumulative losses; regret at most √(T ln N / 2) at the tuned rate.

algorithm.name: AdaGrad (online, diagonal)
algorithm.summary: Scale each coordinate by the root of its summed squared gradients and project in that norm.

algorithm.name: Online gradient descent
algorithm.summary: Step against the latest subgradient and project; regret (3/2)DG√T with ηₜ = D/(G√t).

algorithm.name: Online Newton step
algorithm.summary: Precondition by Aₜ = εI + Σ gₛgₛᵀ and project in its norm; logarithmic regret on exp-concave losses.

algorithm.name: Weighted majority
algorithm.summary: Predict by a weighted vote of the experts and multiply the weight of each expert that errs by β.

algorithm.name: Alternating projections
algorithm.summary: Cycle through the projections onto convex sets until the point stops moving: a point of their intersection.

algorithm.name: Refinement search (beam, best-first, depth-first, breadth-first; branch and bound)
algorithm.summary: Search a space given by a root and a refinement operator for the top k nodes by quality; an optimistic estimate prunes branches that cannot enter the top k.

algorithm.name: OWL-QN
algorithm.summary: L-BFGS for f(x) + C‖x‖₁: pseudo-gradient, orthant-projected direction and backtracking along the projected path.

algorithm.name: Markov chain, step by step
algorithm.summary: A walker drawn from the chain, its visit counts, and the exact distribution p₀Pᵗ beside it.

algorithm.name: Alternating least squares (explicit ratings)
algorithm.summary: Refit every user’s factors by ridge regression on the items fixed, then every item’s; never increases.

algorithm.name: Implicit-feedback ALS (Hu–Koren–Volinsky)
algorithm.summary: Confidence-weighted factorisation of the whole 0/1 matrix, solved in closed form one side at a time.

algorithm.name: Biased matrix factorisation by SGD
algorithm.summary: μ + b_u + b_i + p_uᵀq_i fitted to ratings by minibatch SGD with automatic gradients.

algorithm.name: EMD sifting
algorithm.summary: The sifting iterations that extract one intrinsic mode function.

algorithm.name: Variational mode decomposition
algorithm.summary: ADMM sweeps that fit K narrow-band modes and their centre frequencies together, in the Fourier domain.

algorithm.name: SCRIMP++
algorithm.summary: An anytime matrix profile: PreSCRIMP’s approximation, then exact diagonals in random order.

algorithm.name: Least mean squares (LMS)
algorithm.summary: An adaptive FIR filter that takes one stochastic-gradient step on the squared error per sample.

algorithm.name: Normalised LMS
algorithm.summary: LMS with each step divided by the regressor's energy, so the step size does not depend on the input scale.

algorithm.name: Recursive least squares (RLS)
algorithm.summary: An adaptive FIR filter that keeps the exact exponentially weighted least-squares taps, updated per sample.

algorithm.name: Prediction-error method
algorithm.summary: Damped Gauss–Newton on the one-step prediction error of A y = (B/F) u + C e; gradients by filtering.

algorithm.name: LTI simulation
algorithm.summary: Steps a discrete LTI system x[k+1] = A x[k] + B u[k] through an input sequence.

algorithm.name: Liang's pattern matching
algorithm.summary: Hyphenate a word by patterns: each step applies the patterns starting at one position of .word., keeping the largest digit per gap; odd digits hyphenate.

algorithm.name: PATGEN pattern learning
algorithm.summary: Learn hyphenation patterns level by level from hyphenated words: each step is one pass (a level and a pattern length) keeping candidates with good·w₊ − bad·w₋ ≥ threshold.

algorithm.name: Tokeniser training through a pipeline
algorithm.summary: BPE or WordPiece merges, or unigram pruning rounds, on the pre-tokens the pipeline cuts; a merge or round per step.

algorithm.name: Byte-pair encoding training
algorithm.summary: Merge the most frequent adjacent symbol pair, one merge per step, recording the merge and its count.

algorithm.name: Unigram language-model tokeniser training
algorithm.summary: EM on piece probabilities, then prune the pieces whose removal lowers the likelihood least; a round per step.

algorithm.name: WordPiece training
algorithm.summary: Merge the pair with the highest score c_ab / (c_a c_b) (or likelihood gain), one merge per step.

algorithm.name: ARMA fit by maximum likelihood
algorithm.summary: Nelder–Mead on the exact Gaussian ARMA likelihood over partial-autocorrelation coordinates.

algorithm.name: Exponential smoothing fit
algorithm.summary: Nelder–Mead on the one-step SSE over logit coordinates of the smoothing parameters.

algorithm.name: Seasonal ARIMA fit by maximum likelihood
algorithm.summary: Nelder–Mead on the exact likelihood of the differenced series under the expanded seasonal ARMA.

algorithm.name: EM for a linear-Gaussian state-space model
algorithm.summary: RTS-smoother E-step and closed-form M-step; the log-likelihood never decreases.

algorithm.name: Agglomerative clustering
algorithm.summary: Merge the two closest clusters per step under a linkage rule.

algorithm.name: EM for a Gaussian mixture
algorithm.summary: E-step responsibilities, M-step weights, means and covariances; the log-likelihood never decreases.

algorithm.name: Lloyd's k-means
algorithm.summary: Assign each point to its nearest centroid, then move each centroid to its cluster mean.

algorithm.name: FastICA fixed-point iteration
algorithm.summary: Whitened data, then the symmetric fixed-point update of the unmixing rows on a log-cosh contrast.

algorithm.name: EM for factor analysis and probabilistic PCA
algorithm.summary: EM on x = Wz + μ + ε with diagonal (factor analysis) or isotropic (PPCA) noise; the likelihood never falls.

algorithm.name: SMACOF
algorithm.summary: Majorisation steps (the Guttman transform) that never increase metric stress.

algorithm.name: Batch self-organising map
algorithm.summary: Best-matching units, then neighbourhood-weighted means of the rows under a shrinking radius.

algorithm.name: PaCMAP
algorithm.summary: Adam steps on neighbour, mid-near and further pairs with loss weights that change in three phases.

algorithm.name: t-SNE
algorithm.summary: Gradient steps with gains and early exaggeration on the KL divergence between neighbour distributions.

algorithm.name: UMAP layout
algorithm.summary: One epoch of attractive edge samples and negative samples per step.

bijector.name: affine coupling
bijector.summary: Masked coordinates pass through and condition a scale and shift of the rest: a triangular Jacobian (RealNVP, NICE).

bijector.name: chain
bijector.summary: The composition of bijectors, applied left to right.

bijector.name: ordered
bijector.summary: Maps ℝᴷ onto increasing vectors: the first entry, then positive gaps (ordinal thresholds).

dataset.name: Anscombe's quartet
dataset.summary: Four small datasets with the same summary statistics and different shapes.

dataset.name: Coal-mining disasters
dataset.summary: Yearly counts of British coal-mining disasters, 1851–1962.

dataset.name: Fonts
dataset.summary: Capital-letter outlines of 66 fonts in dense correspondence, one row per font.

dataset.name: Moby hyphenation
dataset.summary: Common English words with dictionary hyphenation points (Moby Hyphenator, public domain), split into train and test words.

dataset.name: Iris
dataset.summary: Fisher's iris measurements: 150 flowers, four features, three species.

dataset.name: Zachary's karate club
dataset.summary: A 34-member friendship graph labelled by the club each member joined after the split.

dataset.name: Old Faithful
dataset.summary: Eruption durations and waiting times of the Old Faithful geyser.

dataset.name: Titanic
dataset.summary: Class, sex, age and survival of the 2201 people aboard the Titanic (R’s Titanic table, one row each).

dataset.name: Autoregressive process
dataset.summary: An AR(2) with a conjugate pole pair of chosen radius and frequency (or any AR(p)), with its analytic PSD.

dataset.name: ARMA process
dataset.summary: An ARMA(2, 2) with a spectral peak from its poles and a notch from its zeros, with its analytic PSD.

dataset.name: Coupled pair of processes
dataset.summary: x an AR(2) and y a delayed low-pass of x plus independent noise, with known cross-spectrum and coherence.

dataset.name: Sinusoids in white noise
dataset.summary: Two sinusoids in white noise: a line spectrum on a flat floor.

dataset.name: Unevenly sampled sinusoid
dataset.summary: A sinusoid observed at random, gapped or nightly-and-seasonal times, with per-sample noise.

dataset.name: Additive model data
dataset.summary: Draws from a GAM: a named shape per uniform feature, through a link, with a Gaussian, binomial, Poisson or gamma response.

dataset.name: Anisotropic blobs
dataset.summary: Gaussian blobs sheared by one linear map, so the clusters are elongated (the scikit-learn k-means example).

dataset.name: Uniform annulus
dataset.summary: Points uniform on a shell around the data: out-of-distribution points for density and energy scores.

dataset.name: AR regimes
dataset.summary: A series that switches between autoregressive regimes at changepoints.

dataset.name: AR series
dataset.summary: An autoregressive series started near stationarity (coefficients default [0.8]).

dataset.name: Attribution task
dataset.summary: Six features with main effects, an interaction pair and two irrelevant ones: a test bed for explanations.

dataset.name: Bars and stripes
dataset.summary: Every bars-and-stripes pattern on a square grid.

dataset.name: Bishop's inverse problem
dataset.summary: t ~ U(0, 1) observed through x = t + 0.3 sin(2πt) + ε; predicting t from x has up to three answers.

dataset.name: Gaussian blobs
dataset.summary: Isotropic Gaussian blobs around random or evenly spaced centres (scikit-learn make_blobs).

dataset.name: Occasionally dishonest casino
dataset.summary: Die rolls from a two-state hidden Markov model: a fair die and a loaded one.

dataset.name: Checkerboard
dataset.summary: Points on a board of alternating tiles, the class given by the tile colour.

dataset.name: Checkerboard image
dataset.summary: A greyscale checkerboard of square tiles.

dataset.name: Concentric circles
dataset.summary: A small circle inside a large one, with Gaussian noise (scikit-learn make_circles).

dataset.name: Class-conditional label noise
dataset.summary: Two classes with a known posterior whose labels are flipped at rates α (class 1) and β (class 0).

dataset.name: Miscalibrated classifier outputs
dataset.summary: Over- or under-confident logits with labels drawn from the true class probabilities.

dataset.name: Click log
dataset.summary: Logged rankings and clicks under a position-bias or cascade click model.

dataset.name: Cocktail party

function.summary: Positive outside the one-class SVM’s or SVDD’s boundary, negative inside.

function.name: One-class SVM
function.summary: Separate the data from the origin in a Gaussian-kernel feature space with maximum margin (dual QP).

function.name: Support vector data description
function.summary: The smallest feature-space ball holding all but a share ν of the data (dual QP).

function.name: Classical MDS
function.summary: The top eigenvectors of the double-centred squared distances.

function.name: Perplexity calibration
function.summary: Per-point Gaussian bandwidths by bisection to a target perplexity.

function.name: Synthetic two-view scene
function.summary: Two pinhole cameras, scene points on a plane or in depth, noisy correspondences with outliers, and the true H and F.

kernel.name: Matérn
kernel.summary: The Matérn kernel with smoothness ν ∈ {1/2, 3/2, 5/2}, given as the first argument.

kernel.name: Polynomial
kernel.summary: The polynomial kernel (σ_b² + σ² xᵀx′)^d, with the degree d given as the first argument.

log-density.name: Banana
log-density.summary: A Gaussian bent into a crescent by a quadratic shift of one coordinate, with exact moments.

log-density.name: Neal's funnel
log-density.summary: A hierarchical funnel whose scale varies over orders of magnitude, hard for fixed-step samplers.

log-density.name: Gaussian mixture target
log-density.summary: An isotropic Gaussian mixture, a multimodal test for samplers; the means and sd are required arguments.

log-density.name: Gaussian target
log-density.summary: A multivariate Gaussian N(μ, Σ); the mean and covariance are required arguments.

log-density.name: Non-centred funnel
log-density.summary: The funnel in its non-centred parametrisation, an isotropic Gaussian, with the map back to the funnel.

loss.name: Contrastive divergence
loss.target: the energy −log p(x) up to a constant

loss.name: Adversarial discriminator loss
loss.target: the log density ratio log p_data/p_g (minimax), or a Lipschitz critic

loss.name: Gaussian negative log-likelihood
loss.target: the conditional mean and standard deviation

loss.name: Huber loss
loss.target: a location between the conditional mean and median

loss.name: Log-cosh loss
loss.target: a location between the conditional mean and median

loss.name: Non-negative PU risk (nnPU)
loss.target: the score of the positive class

loss.name: Proportion loss (LLP)
loss.target: the class logits of each instance

loss.name: Softmax cross-entropy
loss.target: the class log-probabilities, up to a constant per example

loss.name: Unbiased PU risk (uPU)
loss.target: the score of the positive class

loss.name: Sampled softmax
loss.target: the full softmax cross-entropy (with the logQ correction)

model.name: Gaussian process regression
model.summary: Exact GP regression with optional type-II maximum-likelihood hyperparameters; the kernel is a required argument.

model.name: Gaussian process classifier
model.summary: Binary GP classification by the Laplace approximation or EP; the kernel is a required argument.

model.name: Gaussian process ordinal regression
model.summary: A GP latent function with the cumulative probit likelihood, by the Laplace approximation; thresholds, noise and kernel fitted to the evidence. The kernel is a required argument.

model.name: Relevance vector machine
model.summary: Sparse Bayesian kernel regression with one ARD precision per basis function; the kernel is required.

model.name: Sparse Gaussian process regression
model.summary: Inducing-point GP regression (VFE, FITC or DTC); the kernel is a required argument.

model.name: Expectile GAM
model.summary: An additive model of the τ-expectile, fitted by iteratively reweighted least asymmetric squares.

model.name: Explainable boosting machine
model.summary: A GAM of binned shape functions learned by cyclic gradient boosting.

model.name: Generalised additive model
model.summary: A sum of penalised smooth terms with smoothing parameters chosen by REML or GCV; the terms are a required argument.

model.name: Generalised linear model
model.summary: An exponential-family response with a link, fitted by iteratively reweighted least squares; the family is a required argument.

model.name: Logistic regression
model.summary: Binary or softmax logistic regression fitted by Newton steps, with a Bernoulli or categorical predictive.

model.name: Multinomial logistic regression
model.summary: Softmax regression with a reference class and Wald standard errors.

model.name: Negative binomial regression
model.summary: A log-linear count model with an estimated overdispersion θ, alternating IRLS and a θ update.

model.name: Binary decomposition (Frank and Hall)
model.summary: K − 1 logistic classifiers of P(y > k), differenced into class probabilities.

model.name: Deep ordinal regression
model.summary: An MLP score with a CORAL or cumulative-link ordinal head, trained by Adam.

model.name: Ordinal regression
model.summary: Cumulative-link, continuation-ratio or adjacent-category model of ordered classes, fitted by L-BFGS.

model.name: Threshold ordinal regression
model.summary: A linear score and ordered thresholds fitted by the all-threshold or immediate-threshold loss.

model.name: Bernoulli naive Bayes
model.summary: Class-conditional independent binary features with additive smoothing.

model.name: Gaussian naive Bayes
model.summary: Class-conditional independent Gaussians per feature.

model.name: Linear discriminant analysis
model.summary: Gaussian classes with a shared covariance; also projects onto the discriminant directions.

model.name: Multinomial naive Bayes
model.summary: Class-conditional multinomial counts with additive smoothing.

model.name: Quadratic discriminant analysis
model.summary: Gaussian classes, each with its own covariance.

model.name: Crammer–Singer multiclass SVM
model.summary: A single multiclass margin machine solved in the dual.

model.name: Linear SVM
model.summary: The soft-margin linear SVM by dual coordinate descent or Pegasos.

model.name: Support vector machine
model.summary: The soft-margin kernel SVM solved by SMO (kernel default: RBF with lengthscale 1).

model.name: Linear regression
model.summary: Least squares (ridge with an L2 penalty), with a Gaussian predictive.

model.name: Perceptron
model.summary: Rosenblatt's perceptron for two classes, trained by mistake-driven updates.

model.name: Mixture density network
model.summary: An MLP whose outputs are the weights, means and scales of a Gaussian mixture over the target, fitted by maximum likelihood: a multimodal p(y | x).

model.name: k-nearest neighbours
model.summary: Majority (or distance-weighted) vote of the k nearest training points.

model.name: k-nearest neighbours regression
model.summary: The (distance-weighted) mean target of the k nearest training points.

model.name: Max-abs scaler
model.summary: Divide each feature by its largest absolute value.

model.name: Min–max scaler
model.summary: Map each feature linearly onto a range, [0, 1] by default.

model.name: One-hot encoder
model.summary: One indicator column per category.

model.name: Ordinal encoder
model.summary: Each category to its integer index.

model.name: Polynomial features
model.summary: All monomials of the features up to a degree.

model.name: Power transform
model.summary: Box–Cox or Yeo–Johnson transform per feature with λ by maximum likelihood.

model.name: Random Fourier features
model.summary: Random cosine features whose inner products approximate an RBF kernel.

model.name: Robust scaler
model.summary: Centre each feature on its median and scale by its interquartile range.

model.name: Simple imputer
model.summary: Fill missing values per feature with its mean, median, mode or a constant.

model.name: Spline features
model.summary: A B-spline basis per feature.

model.name: Standard scaler
model.summary: Centre each feature and divide by its standard deviation.

model.name: Target encoder
model.summary: Each category to a shrunk mean of the target.

model.name: Whitening
model.summary: A linear map to identity covariance (PCA or ZCA whitening).

model.name: Nested dichotomies
model.summary: A binary tree of class splits whose branch probabilities multiply to class probabilities.

model.name: One versus one
model.summary: K(K−1)/2 pairwise binary problems combined by voting.

model.name: One versus rest
model.summary: K binary problems, each class against the rest; a predictive when the binary base has one. Capabilities declared for a logistic-regression base.

model.name: Error-correcting output codes
model.summary: One binary problem per column of a code matrix, decoded by Hamming or loss distance; the code is a required argument.

model.name: Random forest
model.summary: Bagged classification trees with random feature subsets at each split.

model.name: AdaBoost
model.summary: SAMME boosting of shallow trees (stumps by default).

model.name: Gradient boosting
model.summary: Stagewise fitting of regression trees to the negative gradient of a squared or logistic loss.

model.name: Decision tree
model.summary: CART classification tree grown greedily, with cost-complexity pruning.

model.name: Regression tree
model.summary: CART regression tree on squared error, with cost-complexity pruning.

model.name: Tiny character-level GPT
model.summary: A decoder-only transformer trained by next-character prediction, small enough to train in a browser.

model.name: Kneser–Ney n-gram language model
model.summary: Interpolated (optionally modified) Kneser–Ney smoothing of n-gram counts, with continuation counts.

model.name: Agglomerative clustering
model.summary: Repeated merging of the closest clusters under a linkage, cut into flat clusters.

model.name: DBSCAN
model.summary: Density-connected core points form clusters; the rest is noise.

model.name: Gaussian mixture
model.summary: A mixture of Gaussians fitted by EM; soft assignments are its predictive.

model.name: k-medoids
model.summary: Clusters represented by data points (medoids), by alternating assignment and medoid update.

model.name: k-means
model.summary: Lloyd's algorithm from k-means++ seeds, best of several restarts.

model.name: Mean shift
model.summary: Points climb a kernel density estimate to its modes, which are the clusters.

model.name: Mini-batch k-means
model.summary: k-means with centroid updates from random mini-batches.

model.name: OPTICS
model.summary: The reachability ordering of the points, from which DBSCAN clusterings at every ε can be read.

model.name: Spectral clustering
model.summary: k-means on the leading eigenvectors of a normalised graph Laplacian.

model.name: Factor analysis
model.summary: A Gaussian with low-rank-plus-diagonal covariance WWᵀ + Ψ, fitted by EM; scores are posterior means.

model.name: FastICA
model.summary: Independent sources by whitening and the symmetric fixed-point iteration on a log-cosh contrast.

model.name: Kernel PCA
model.summary: PCA in the feature space of a kernel (RBF by default).

model.name: Metric multidimensional scaling
model.summary: An embedding whose distances match the data distances, by SMACOF stress majorisation.

model.name: Principal component analysis
model.summary: Projection onto the directions of largest variance.

model.name: Probabilistic PCA
model.summary: Factor analysis with isotropic noise σ²I: closed-form maximum likelihood from the eigendecomposition, or EM.

model.name: Diffusion map
model.summary: Eigenvectors of a random walk on a Gaussian kernel, scaled so distances are diffusion distances.

model.name: Isomap
model.summary: Classical MDS of geodesic distances on a nearest-neighbour graph.

model.name: Laplacian eigenmaps
model.summary: The smallest non-trivial eigenvectors of a nearest-neighbour graph Laplacian.

model.name: Locally linear embedding
model.summary: An embedding that keeps each point’s reconstruction weights from its neighbours.

model.name: Self-organising map
model.summary: A grid of prototypes fitted by batch neighbourhood-weighted means under a shrinking radius.

model.name: PaCMAP
model.summary: Neighbour, mid-near and further pairs with phased loss weights, so the layout keeps global structure.

model.name: t-SNE
model.summary: Matching Gaussian neighbour probabilities with Student-t ones in the embedding, by gradient descent on their KL divergence.

model.name: UMAP
model.summary: A fuzzy nearest-neighbour graph laid out by stochastic gradient descent on a cross-entropy.

modifier.name: Shuffle
modifier.summary: Put the rows in a random order (generators group points by class).

modifier.name: Covariate shift
modifier.summary: Keep rows with a probability that rises along a direction in feature space.

modifier.name: Label noise
modifier.summary: Flip each label to another class at random with probability `rate`.

modifier.name: Label shift
modifier.summary: Resample within classes to new class shares, keeping p(x | y): a label shift.

modifier.name: Missing values
modifier.summary: Remove entries completely at random, at random given another feature, or not at random.

modifier.name: Nuisance features
modifier.summary: Append features drawn independently of everything else.

modifier.name: Outliers
modifier.summary: Replace a fraction of rows by draws from a broad Gaussian around the data mean.

modifier.name: Prevalence
modifier.summary: Resample within classes to a target share of class 1.

modifier.name: Linear map
modifier.summary: Rotate, shear and stretch the first two features (or apply any affine map); the truth maps along.

objective.name: Beale
objective.summary: A two-dimensional surface with sharp ridges and its minimum at (3, 0.5).

objective.name: Himmelblau
objective.summary: A two-dimensional surface with four global minima of value 0.

objective.name: Quadratic bowl
objective.summary: A convex quadratic with condition number κ, rotated in two dimensions.

objective.name: Rastrigin
objective.summary: A bowl covered in a regular grid of local minima; the global minimum is 0 at the origin.

objective.name: Rosenbrock
objective.summary: A curved, narrow valley with its minimum at (a, a², …): slow for gradient descent.

primitive.name: stopGradient
primitive.summary: x itself, treated as a constant by every derivative transform.

primitive.name: conv
primitive.summary: N-dimensional convolution (or cross-correlation) of [N, C, ...S] inputs with [O, C/groups, ...K] kernels.

primitive.name: convTranspose
primitive.summary: The transposed convolution: the adjoint of conv in its input.

primitive.name: convWeight
primitive.summary: The adjoint of conv in its kernel (the weight gradient).

primitive.name: linearFilter
primitive.summary: The output of the difference equation with feedforward coefficients b and feedback coefficients a.

primitive.name: pad
primitive.summary: Pad each axis by [lo, hi] samples read by a border mode.

primitive.name: padAdjoint
primitive.summary: The adjoint of pad: cotangents added back onto the positions they were read from.

primitive.name: fft
primitive.summary: The discrete Fourier transform along an axis (radix-2 or Bluestein).
primitive.formula: X_k = s \sum_{t=0}^{n-1} x_t e^{-2\pi i kt/n}

primitive.name: ifft
primitive.summary: The inverse discrete Fourier transform along an axis.
primitive.formula: x_t = s \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} X_k e^{2\pi i kt/n}

primitive.name: irfft
primitive.summary: The real signal of length n whose non-negative half-spectrum is the input (Hermitian extension).
primitive.formula: x_t = s \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} X_k e^{2\pi i kt/n}, \; X_{n-k} = \overline{X_k}

primitive.name: rfft
primitive.summary: The DFT of a real signal at its non-negative frequencies k = 0, …, ⌊n/2⌋.
primitive.formula: X_k = s \sum_{t=0}^{n-1} x_t e^{-2\pi i kt/n}, \; 0 \le k \le \lfloor n/2 \rfloor

primitive.name: abs
primitive.summary: The absolute value |x|.

primitive.name: add
primitive.summary: The sum a + b.

primitive.name: angle
primitive.summary: The argument (phase) arg z = atan2(y, x) in (−π, π].

primitive.name: argmax
primitive.summary: The index of the largest element.

primitive.name: argmin
primitive.summary: The index of the smallest element.

primitive.name: broadcastTo
primitive.summary: Broadcast to a shape by NumPy rules.

primitive.name: complex
primitive.summary: The complex number re + i·im.

primitive.name: complexAbs
primitive.summary: The modulus |z| = √(x² + y²) of a complex number.

primitive.name: concat
primitive.summary: Join tensors along an existing axis.

primitive.name: conj
primitive.summary: The complex conjugate x − iy.

primitive.name: cos
primitive.summary: The cosine (radians).

primitive.name: cumsum
primitive.summary: Running sums along an axis.

primitive.name: div
primitive.summary: The quotient a / b.

primitive.name: einsum
primitive.summary: Einstein summation over letter-labelled axes.

primitive.name: equalTo
primitive.summary: a = b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: euclideanNorm
primitive.summary: The Euclidean norm √Σx², scaled against overflow.

primitive.name: exp
primitive.summary: The exponential eˣ.

primitive.name: expj
primitive.summary: The unit phasor e^{iθ}.

primitive.name: expm1
primitive.summary: eˣ − 1, accurate for small x.

primitive.name: gather
primitive.summary: Read elements at flat indices.

primitive.name: greater
primitive.summary: a > b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: greaterEqual
primitive.summary: a ≥ b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: imagPart
primitive.summary: The imaginary part y of z = x + iy, as a zero-copy float64 view.

primitive.name: less
primitive.summary: a < b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: lessEqual
primitive.summary: a ≤ b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: linearCombination
primitive.summary: The linear combination Σ cᵢ xᵢ of same-shaped inputs with fixed coefficients.

primitive.name: log
primitive.summary: The natural logarithm.

primitive.name: log1p
primitive.summary: log(1 + x), accurate for small x.

primitive.name: logsumexp
primitive.summary: log Σ exp(x), without overflow.

primitive.name: matmul
primitive.summary: Batched matrix product with broadcast batch axes.

primitive.name: max
primitive.summary: The largest element.

primitive.name: maximum
primitive.summary: The larger of a and b.

primitive.name: min
primitive.summary: The smallest element.

primitive.name: minimum
primitive.summary: The smaller of a and b.

primitive.name: mul
primitive.summary: The product a·b.

primitive.name: neg
primitive.summary: Negation −x.

primitive.name: notEqualTo
primitive.summary: a ≠ b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: permute
primitive.summary: Reorder the axes.

primitive.name: pow
primitive.summary: The power aᵇ.

primitive.name: prod
primitive.summary: The product of the elements.

primitive.name: realPart
primitive.summary: The real part x of z = x + iy, as a zero-copy float64 view.

primitive.name: reshape
primitive.summary: The same elements with a new shape.

primitive.name: scatterAdd
primitive.summary: Add values into flat indices: the adjoint of gather.

primitive.name: scatterSlice
primitive.summary: Zeros with values written into a slice: the adjoint of slicing.

primitive.name: sign
primitive.summary: The sign of x: −1, 0 or 1.

primitive.name: sin
primitive.summary: The sine (radians).

primitive.name: slice
primitive.summary: Basic indexing: a view of part of a tensor.

primitive.name: sqrt
primitive.summary: The square root.

primitive.name: square
primitive.summary: The square x².

primitive.name: sub
primitive.summary: The difference a − b.

primitive.name: sum
primitive.summary: The sum of the elements.

primitive.name: sumTo
primitive.summary: Sum down to a shape: the adjoint of broadcasting.

primitive.name: tanh
primitive.summary: The hyperbolic tangent.

primitive.name: where
primitive.summary: Elementwise choice: a where the condition is non-zero, b elsewhere.

primitive.name: distanceFromSquared
primitive.summary: √u with derivative 0 at u = 0, for distances inside kernels.

primitive.name: relu
primitive.summary: The rectified linear unit max(0, x).

primitive.name: cholesky
primitive.summary: The Cholesky factor L of a symmetric positive-definite matrix, LLᵀ = A.

primitive.name: det
primitive.summary: The determinant of a square matrix.

primitive.name: eigh
primitive.summary: Eigenvalues (descending) and orthonormal eigenvectors of a symmetric matrix.

primitive.name: expm
primitive.summary: The matrix exponential e^A.

primitive.name: logDet
primitive.summary: log |det A|.

primitive.name: lu
primitive.summary: The unpacked LU factors L, U and the permutation P of PA = LU with partial pivoting.

primitive.name: luSolve
primitive.summary: Solve A X = B (or Aᵀ X = B) by substitution with the LU factor of A.

primitive.name: qr
primitive.summary: The reduced QR factorisation by Householder reflections.

primitive.name: solveTriangular
primitive.summary: Solve a triangular system by substitution.

primitive.name: svd
primitive.summary: The thin singular value decomposition of a tall matrix.

primitive.name: atan
primitive.summary: The arctangent.

primitive.name: standardCauchyCdf
primitive.summary: The standard Cauchy cdf.

primitive.name: standardCauchyQuantile
primitive.summary: The standard Cauchy quantile.
